This musician joined Coltrane and Peterson in a rendition of Monk's "Hackensack" in a legendary concert that was televised in Germany. The first movement of this symphony uses a sudden sustained A-flat note when merging its allegro moderato section into a poco adagio section, which signals a departure from the symphony's home key into the new key of D-flat major. Name this final numbered symphony of Camille Saint-Saens, usually named for a keyboard instrument.

A building in this city contains interlocking T-shaped water basins surrounded by gypsum panels that show nature scenes. Name this English composer of My Ladye Nevells Booke who studied under Thomas Tallis.

Name this Aaron Copland ballet suite about the life of a Wild West outlaw.

At the bottom of a landscape named for one of these objects, a row of white curves is separated by a tree from a set of angles and lines.
